description: Replace this scene screen with the supported screen shape returned by get_project_context. Read get_project_context first and pass its base_version and selected output_id. Saves a playable project; request a file separately with check_video with_download. Unsupported changes refuse without rebuilding. Preserve operation_id and exact inputs on retries. Uses the account's direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version the edits are for; the current one when left out.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

output_id.description: One output (a hook, a Short, a format) from check_video; the main film when left out.

screen.description: A screen in the shape get_project_context shows for that scene.

outputSchema.description: Clypmint replace_scene_screen result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
